request.prompt:
Goods: NITRILE EXAMINATION GLOVES, BOX OF 100
Country of origin: TH

Chosen so far: 40 Rubber and articles thereof > 4015 Articles of apparel and clothing accessories (including gloves, mittens and mitts), for all purposes, of vulcanised rubber other than hard rubber

Choose the subheading that covers these goods. Options:
- 401519: Rubber; vulcanised (other than hard rubber), gloves, mittens and mitts other than surgical gloves
- 401512: Rubber; vulcanised (other than hard rubber), gloves, of a kind used for medical, surgical, dental or veterinary purposes
- 401590: Rubber; vulcanised (other than hard rubber), articles of apparel and clothing accessories (other than gloves, mittens and mitts)

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: Nitrile examination gloves are vulcanised rubber gloves of a kind used for medical purposes, which fall under subheading 4015.12 rather than the other gloves in 4015.19.
